Take a look Guns of Eschaton coop gameplay, a soulslike FPS set in an occult Wild West created by the late, renowned writer and worldbuilder Viktor Antonov (Half-Life 2, Dishonoured, Prey, Fallout 4, Wolfenstein: The New Order).  

This is not a fast-paced shooter where victory comes from reflexes alone. Every bullet matters. Every gun has its own character. Every monster has a weakness. So be smart with your ammo choice in each cylinder of your revolver. Learn enemy weaknesses and exploit them. Adapt your tactics with different bullet types, calculated parries and dashes, mystic abilities granted through occult means.

Go West and die with the country.

description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019038

When Dodo’s dream of becoming an actor falls apart, the young duck returns home to Mirth Island in search of a new purpose.
 
There, he discovers that the legendary theatre that first inspired him has been left in ruins. Together with his childhood friends Vivi and Rita, Dodo sets out to restore the theatre and bring its stage back to life.
 
Explore a colorful island filled with charming locals, adorable animals, and stories waiting to be discovered. Help the islanders with their everyday problems, form meaningful friendships, and enjoy playful rhythm minigames along the way.
 
Through perseverance, friendship, and small acts of kindness, Dodo may discover that rebuilding the theatre could also help him heal his own heart.
